name: Vijana of Yamune
source:
Vijana of Yamune is a servant of the Order of the Universal Panacea who's supposed to be working at the Sanctuary of Apsu at the time of the conclave as the cook. Her mysterious absence is one of the first signs that something isn't right.

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Vijana_of_Yamune]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
